--OrdersStg

with source as (
    select * from "ecommerce"."RAW"."raw_orders"
),

cleaned as (
    select
        order_id::integer                               as order_id,
        trim(customer_id)::text                         as customer_id,
        store_id::text                                  as store_id,
        order_date::date                                as order_date,
        lower(trim(status))::text                       as order_status,
        coalesce(shipping_fee, 0)::numeric(12,2)        as shipping_fee,
        currency :: text                                as currency
    from source
),

deduped as (
    select *
    from (
        select *,
               row_number() over (partition by order_id order by order_date desc) as rn
        from cleaned
    ) ranked
    where rn = 1
)

select * from deduped

with order_items as (

    select * from "ecommerce"."STAGE"."stg_order_items"

),

orders as (

    select * from "ecommerce"."STAGE"."stg_orders"

),

products as (

    select * from "ecommerce"."STAGE"."stg_products"

),

joins as (

    select
        order_items.*,
        orders.customer_id,
        orders.store_id,
        orders.order_date,
        orders.order_status,
        products.cost_price

    from order_items
    left join orders on order_items.order_id = orders.order_id
    left join products on order_items.product_id = products.product_id

),

    
facts as (

    select
        oi.*,
        oi.quantity * oi.price                                                              as gross_amount,
        oi.quantity * oi.price * oi.discount / 100                                          as discount_amount,
        
    (oi.quantity * oi.price * (1 - oi.discount / 100.0))
::numeric(12,2)           as net_amount,
        oi.quantity * oi.cost_price                                                         as total_cost,
        
    (oi.quantity * oi.price * (1 - oi.discount / 100.0))

            - (quantity * cost_price)                                                       as margin

    from joins as oi

)

select * from facts


where order_item_id > (select coalesce(max(order_item_id), 0) from "ecommerce"."DEV"."fct_order_items")

with orders as (

    select *
    from "ecommerce"."STAGE"."stg_orders"

),

order_items as (

    select *
    from "ecommerce"."DEV"."fct_order_items"

),

item_rollup as (

    select
        order_id,
        count(*) as num_line_items,
        sum(quantity) as total_quantity,
        sum(net_amount) as net_revenue

    from order_items

    group by order_id

),

final as (

    select
        o.order_id,
        o.order_status,
        o.customer_id,
        o.store_id,
        o.order_date,
        o.shipping_fee,

        coalesce(r.num_line_items, 0) as num_line_items,
        coalesce(r.total_quantity, 0) as total_quantity,
        coalesce(r.net_revenue, 0) as net_revenue,

        coalesce(r.net_revenue, 0)
            + coalesce(o.shipping_fee, 0) as order_total

    from orders o

    left join item_rollup r
        on o.order_id = r.order_id

)

select *
from final
